objective: Empirically qualify narrative-state and orchestration extraction before any automated extractor can become authoritative.
why_this_is_next: STEP-008 opportunity admission is implemented and hosted-qualified.
Canonical narrative-state representation + provenance-bound materialization are implemented and hosted-qualified.
Global narrative orchestration representation is implemented and hosted-qualified.
Creative-judge robustness analyzer is implemented and hosted-qualified.
The remaining missing evidence is extraction accuracy/calibration, not conceptual coverage.

allowed: synthetic narratives authored specifically for qualification
public-domain literary passages with documented provenance
user-owned/authorized text only when explicitly supplied for qualification
gold_source_policy.split_rule: Hold out entire source works/authors where practical. Do not split adjacent passages from the same work across train/tune/test when that could leak structure/style.

metrics: span overlap/IoU when token spans exist

selective_prediction.rule: A lower-coverage extractor with materially lower false-certainty may outrank a high-coverage extractor for canonical authority.

metrics: Brier score where labels are binary
calibration.rule: Confidence is evidence quality metadata, never prose-quality score.

stress_slices: repeated narration of the same event
surface-style attractiveness conflicting with story function
implementation_sequence: 1. Define gold/prediction/receipt schemas and stable source-held-out split manifest.
2. Build a synthetic qualification corpus designed around the stress slices without copying any user manuscript.
3. Implement scoring + selective-risk/calibration harness independent of any extractor provider.
4. Define extractor-provider interface that outputs candidate observations only; provider cannot write canonical state directly.
5. Run a deterministic/no-model baseline to prove harness failure detection.
6. Add one candidate extractor/provider and run hosted small calibration where resources permit.
7. Only after hosted evidence is green, prepare a registered A-01 qualification wrapper for larger source-held-out campaigns if Windows compute materially helps.
8. Central portfolio prep, not this workstream, decides whether/when to admit an A-01 ticket.

required: per-task evidence rather than one aggregate quality score
evaluator-robustness standing compatible with automated comparison

daytime_first_action: Implement the provider-independent calibration schemas + scorer + synthetic stress corpus. Do not start with an LLM prompt; first make incorrect extraction measurable.
stop_condition: Do not add more prose taxonomies until extraction calibration exposes a concrete missing label/state/metric. Do not grant automatic extractor authority until source-held-out false-certainty, ambiguity preservation and per-task accuracy are empirically acceptable.
